payload.title: Reconcile Qwen terminal failure with already-set worker acceptance
payload.summary: P2 maintained worker outcome contract. On main7a657dba, a tiny real Git task uses native inspect_source, one exact edit, real tests/oracle/Ruff/format/mypy, model-invoked check_changes and host is_current. After accepted=True is set, a deterministic OSError at turn3 stage.json completion persistence is caught by run_coding_task, which changes disposition to CONTEXT_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED but leaves accepted=True. result.json is saved with both fields, original source restored, candidate and passing check evidence retained. Actual coding_worker.main fed that returned worker result exits0. Reproduced twice; valid shared-check control returns ACCEPTED. This is inconsistent task-level failure/acceptance reporting, not evidence that the candidate fails its checks or that protected publication is bypassed.
payload.benefit: Within existing worker owners make fatal task exceptions and final accepted/disposition/CLI status consistent. Preserve known provider responses, candidate/check facts, unknown effects and conservative source restoration; do not retry or erase results. Acceptance: actual run_coding_task reaches real accepted native checks, then controlled completion-stage write failure, returning nonaccepted failure or a separately explicitly approved qualified outcome; CLI must not report unqualified success for fatal worker failure. Include normal shared completion, prepared mode, cancellation, before/after edit and final-result persistence errors. Full committed-tree production validation required only in a separately authorized repair. Do not implement the unapproved optional ModelInteraction observer policy to fix this application outcome defect.
payload.uncertainty: Fault injection targets a genuine owned filesystem save after validation; no real disk failure, live model, GitHub fault or production task was executed. Local closeout initially trusts accepted for candidate admission but independently revalidates source/review/protected publication. The current governed assignment-v1 does not enable this native shared-completion option. Delivered frozen-input/budget/source-provenance fixes remain separate and correct. B-0011/B-0034 broader durability and observer OptionB conditions remain unapproved.
